summary: Inside the hovercraft, Tank is clicking at the keyboard, searching for an exit, while Trinity screams an urgent warning into her headset, telling Neo to get back immediately.

what_changes.before: focused on Tank's search for an exit
what_changes.after: urgently demanding Neo return, implying imminent danger
what_changes.evidence: Trinity screams into the headset. TRINITY Neo, you better get your ass back here!

event_hint.one_line: The crew scrambles to extract Neo while Trinity senses danger closing in.

uncertain: Whether Neo is actually in immediate danger or Trinity is reacting to something Tank found.
The exact nature of the exit Tank is searching for.
